title: Software Engineer (Backend) Intern
text:
Location: India (Work from Home)

At DiligenceVault, we’re the leading technology platform and industry network to streamline and digitize the manually intensive diligence process. We have experienced a wonderful period of growth as the direct result of increased efficiency and productivity for our network of over 100,000 platform users in over 150 countries. To continue on this trajectory, we are looking for exceptional talent from across disciplines and industries to shape the future of due diligence and improve the lives of our clients and users in a meaningful way. We are a team that is passionate about building an experience that users love, a team that takes pride in their effort, a team that argues over technical accuracy, but is flexible too. A team that realizes that we are not going to create a world class solution in a single iteration. A team of smart, motivated, interesting and fun people to take the firm to the next level.

Internship Details:

Position Details:
● Role: Software Engineer Intern
● Mode: Remote (Work from Home)
● Internship Duration: 6 months 
● Target Batch: B.Tech (Computer Science/ AI & ML ) - 2026 graduates

Internship Responsibilities:
● Evaluate libraries/tools and develop Proof of Concepts (PoCs)
● Analyze and optimize results and performance
● Convert PoCs into working modules using Python & SQL

Required Skills:
● Prior Internship experience in Python (strongly preferred)
● Strong proficiency in Python & SQL
● Understanding of AI/ML concepts (preferred)
● Strong problem-solving skills and solid grasp of Data Structures & Algorithms

Benefits:
● Stipend: Ranges between 20,000 to 30,000 per month based on interview performance
● Hands-on experience with modern tech stacks
● Opportunity to work in a fast-paced startup environment
● Pre-Placement Offer (PPO): High-performing interns will be eligible for a PPO, which will be formally extended after successful completion of their degree, allowing a smooth transition to a full-time role post-graduation.

Eligibility Criteria:
● B.Tech/ B.E. in Computer Science only
● Minimum CGPA of 7.5
● No active backlogs or failed subjects
● Availability for a 6-month full-time internship

title: Remote Full Stack Developer - G2i Talent Pool
text:
Join the G2i Talent Pool
We’re always meeting great people in tech. Join the G2i Talent Pool and let us get to know you.
G2i works with top AI labs and fast-growing companies. Our community of engineers works on real projects, from evals and RL environments to training data for frontier models.
Who we’re looking for
Software, data, AI/ML, infrastructure, security, design, QA and product. Experienced or just starting out, fresh graduates are welcome. If you work in tech or are building your career in it, we’d love to meet you.
How it works

Apply in a few minutes with your real details and links.

We review your profile and send you a short technical assessment.

Once you pass, you join our pool and hear from us when a project fits your skills.

Joining the pool doesn’t mean immediate work, since matching depends on what our clients need and on each profile. But we’re always working to match everyone in our pool with the right project.

Please note that eligibility may vary depending on your location, as some regions may not be supported by the client.

title: Assurance Engineering Platform Developer SMTS / LMTS
text:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job CategorySoftware Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

We are seeking a lead full stack engineer with enterprise software engineering experience to drive the architecture, technical roadmap, and execution for our next-generation Security Assurance Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platform. In this role, you will hold end-to-end technical ownership over the platform’s core engines—including policy as code, compliance as code, automated evidence collection, telemetry and alerting, and risk evaluation modules.

Beyond hands-on development in Python, Java, and modern front-end frameworks, you will act as a primary technical leader: defining system architecture, scoping and planning multi-quarter technical initiatives, and guiding distributed feature teams from concept through deployment. You will also pioneer the team’s operational strategy around AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, Gemini, OpenAI) to accelerate output and elevate code quality across the engineering organization.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

End-to-End Ownership: Take technical ownership of complex, multi-system initiatives, driving architectural decisions, technical specifications, phase planning, and execution across the delivery lifecycle.
Architecture & System Design: Architect resilient, cloud-native microservice architectures that process large-scale compliance telemetry, support automated evidence ingestion, and execute low-latency risk evaluation engines.
Roadmap & Project Planning: Partner with Product Management, Security Architects, and GRC leaders to translate broad business and regulatory strategies into detailed technical roadmaps, milestones, and sprint backlogs.
Technical Governance: Establish engineering standards, perform high-impact code and architecture reviews, enforce secure coding guidelines, and institute rigorous CI/CD and testing benchmarks across the engineering org.
Policy & Governance as Code: Design and implement extensible Policy as Code and Compliance as Code engines (e.g., leveraging Open Policy Agent/OPA or custom evaluation frameworks) and runtime platforms (e.g. CSPM, EDR, etc) that dynamically audit infrastructure and enterprise controls. Constrain the outputs of AI coding assistants with declarative machine-readable rules.
Automated Evidence Collection: Lead the design of automated evidence collection pipelines integrating with multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), identity providers, enterprise security tools, CI/CD pipelines, ticketing systems, and productivity / corporate applications (Workday, Netsuite, etc).
Risk & Regulatory Modeling: Build dynamic risk analysis engines and auditing interfaces capable of mapping continuous technical evidence against major regulatory standards (NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2).
AI-Assisted Engineering: Lead the adoption and integration of AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, Gemini, OpenAI APIs) across the engineering lifecycle to optimize team productivity, automate test generation, and streamline refactoring.
Mentorship: Actively mentor senior and mid-level engineers across time zones, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning.
Lead cross-functional alignment
